questions.question: What's the actual impact of fees and slippage on retail-size paper-traded crypto strategies?
questions.summary: ~$1/round-trip on $200 positions (0.25% taker both legs). Gross +$1,085 became net -$782 on the 3-month backtest — the delta is the answer. Fees erase thin edges.

questions.question: Which parameter ranges of Bollinger and MA-crossover are robust to regime shifts, and which are overfit?
questions.summary: None are robust: all 12 variants with n>100 negative over 6 months net of costs. Per-regime conditioning untested (rung 3).

questions.question: (Emergent) Do constraints or strategies determine outcomes at this scale?

learnings.claim: Short-horizon crypto continuation (≤24h, taker) has gross edge below the cost floor at every horizon ≤12h and cannot clear costs.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 K1 adjudication: short-horizon crypto archived; ceiling-study evidence

learnings.claim: The cost lever (maker fills) mechanically works: maker beat taker in 12/12 matched pairs, ~$0.21-0.24 fees saved per trade, with near-zero fill loss because the strategy buys into falling price.
The first net-positive backtest configuration (maker·72h·tp8%/sl4% = +$0.031/slot over 146 trades) is an edge statistically indistinguishable from zero and biased by multiple-comparisons selection.
All five LLM-surfaced candidates in the 180-day constrained replay lost money net of fees; weekend_illiquidity_momentum was gross-positive but fee-negative, replicating the fee-floor failure shape.

Both base strategies (Bollinger Band mean-reversion and MA-crossover) fail to clear the bar over the 6-month window; every variant with n>100 is negative and the only positives run on n=3 and n=13 (noise).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 Retire Bollinger and MA-crossover; 6-month replay 2026-01-03 to 2026-07-02, net -$1,719.44

learnings.claim: GitHub Actions free-tier */5 cron delivers only ~3-5% of scheduled invocations on public bot-only repos, making the 95% uptime gate unclearable on that platform.
learnings.evidence: 2026-05-23 Migrating cron to Hetzner VPS; six days of cron data 2026-05-17 to 2026-05-23 (4.0% invocation rate)

learnings.claim: The Hetzner VPS migration mechanically satisfied Phase 2 architectural gate 1 (≥95% uptime): 11,490+ fetch runs with zero gaps over ~1 hour across the 47-day window.

Elapsed calendar time did not produce learning: nearly everything the project learned came from ~48 hours (2026-07-16/17), and eleven weeks of calendar bought only one day of live A/B trade-days (the only incompressible resource).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 Correction: the sequence was valuable; the duration was not

learnings.claim: The gauntlet's detection power is near zero where interesting edges live: a true +0.17%-net edge passes only 32% at n=100, and reliable detection starts ~+0.6% net; the +0.3% kill bar has a 21% false-positive rate at n=7.

The blind-elicitation exercise produced more validated learning in one day than any week of inside work (ceiling study, power calibration, netting insight, slow-band prior, cost decomposition all trace to it).
The .env exposure (May 2026) exposed only the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to a session transcript; git-history search confirmed no real credential was ever committed to the repo.
Logging the .env incident ~60 days late lost the facts that would matter in a real postmortem (exact date, echoing command, transcript persistence), while the write-up cost only ten minutes.
Alpaca crypto venue spreads range 0.07% (BTC) to 0.42% (SOL) versus Binance ≤0.015%, so fees+spread are selectable by symbol/order-type/venue; only slippage requires real trades to measure.

Equity time-series momentum in 2024-26 lost to drift in-window (0/9 long-or-flat vs-drift cells); only the cross-sectional 6-1 spread was persistently positive but weakly significant (single-window t≈1, pooled t≈1.9, survivorship-inflated).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 The equity sky check, sober reading

learnings.claim: Survivorship is fixable at zero data cost because Alpaca serves full daily bars for delisted names (SIVB, FRC, SBNY, BBBYQ, MULN all returned).

The survivorship-corrected point-in-time re-score weakened the cross-sectional 6-1 spread: 2020-21 flipped to -2.57%/mo, pooled fell to +1.25%±1.23/mo (t=+1.02), collapsing the pooled t toward zero and flipping a window's sign.

The E2 equity pipeline is validated: cross-sectional 12-1 momentum was detected with the correct sign and the textbook Daniel-Moskowitz momentum-crash signature (-17.3%/yr in 2020-21 rebound, +28.9%/yr in 2024-26).

The +14.9%/yr round-zero momentum magnitude is not a deployable edge: far above the pre-registered 2-4%/yr band, only marginally significant (t=1.57, n=59), and ran on a modified pass (n=59 months, not the registered 20+ years) because Alpaca history reaches only ~2021.
The 59-month equity test window is typical, not a freak regime: French UMD 2021-26 +0.47%/mo vs 1927-present +0.62%/mo, z=-0.26.

The measured equity object is momentum, confirmed chiefly by storm-conditional co-movement: tilt-vs-UMD correlation is +0.49 in high-|UMD| storm months versus +0.09 in calm months (full-sample only +0.26).
No single equity price/volume factor clears the best-of-4 hurdle (~1.7t) on the liquid large-cap universe at monthly horizon; momentum is the only positive at t=1.57, the rest noise or negative.

The equity price-factor structure (single and combined, across weekly/monthly/quarterly, on liquid large-caps) is a measured NULL: efficient after costs, and multi-factor composites reduce excess/IR versus momentum-alone.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 E2 equity price-factor structure declared NULL

learnings.claim: Crypto shock-fade at a 72h pure hold is a genuine lead but not a candidate: n=18 (fails the n<30 quarantine), horizon-unstable (72h alive t=2.34, 120h dead), and the placebo is itself regime-flipping, so the family rides the 2024-25 reversion regime.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 D1 shock-fade: first genuine LEAD, quarantined

learnings.claim: Directional price prediction of mispricing is the one capability the project never demonstrated across ~40 falsifications in both markets; the realized product is the instrument + registry + knowledge, not returns.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 Next chapter set: the instrument is the product

learnings.claim: Funding carry is venue-blocked on Alpaca (spot-only), so the constitution admitted it only as delta-neutral basis with ≤5%/venue sizing and no capital could move.

The VRP harvester machine runs end-to-end on Alpaca paper: at the real 20% richness bar it correctly skips (SPY/QQQ/IWM premium 4-15% of width, genuinely thin) and the paper multi-leg order path is confirmed (SPY 705/700p spread accepted, status 200).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 VRP harvester built + VRP machine fully validated end-to-end

learnings.claim: The LLM stand-aside rule as first built was too blunt: it defaulted to generic caution because every 5-week window has a CPI/FOMC and guessed macro dates it couldn't know; refined v2 correctly writes when scheduled events are already priced.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 VRP harvester built; VRP machine fully validated end-to-end

learnings.claim: Defined-risk VRP is a breadth game not a size game: ~$25k functional floor, $50-100k sweet spot; expected total-book return ~5-8%/yr of which ~half is T-bill yield on idle cash and the VRP edge adds only ~2-4 points, with a fat negative left tail.

Moving the option strike closer (0.5-SD) does not create edge: it clears the flat 20% gate ~10x more often only because 20% is too cheap for a strike with ~31% assignment odds; held to its own delta-fair bar the closer strike is fairly paid LESS often than the 1-SD strike.

The delta-fair bar used to judge VRP richness was partly self-referential because the N(-sd) breakeven comes from the same realized-vol Gaussian that places the strike; no VRP profitability is established, only 'not obviously mispriced'.
TLT was never fairly paid at either strike distance (0% at 1-SD, 1.7% at 0.5-SD), suggesting the equity variance-risk-premium may simply not exist in rate-driven bond options.

Charter E is dead at Stage 0 on both sides: longshot-sell all-in cost 2-8c (~80-107% of price) and near-certainty-buy 3-5c both dwarf a plausible 1-2pp edge — a structural Kalshi fee-takeout (~80% at 2.5c), not a market condition.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-31 Charter E DEAD at Stage 0; event-venue-floor-2026-07-31.json

learnings.claim: The Kalshi adapter's max_pages=30 default silently truncated the market population and hid the entire >90c tail, reproducing the no-silent-caps failure mode in the project's own code (fixed to max_pages=800).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-31 Charter E DEAD at Stage 0 process note

learnings.claim: SEC EDGAR 8-K metadata is the best mechanism-to-effort ratio among fetchable text sources (free, stable, ~370 filings/day); the stronger-mechanism token-unlock lead has no free data source (DefiLlama paywalled 402).
The Option-A commit-back (trader.db/context.db every 5 min) regrows .git to ~11 GB in ~1.5 days, forcing gc cadence from weekly to daily to bound disk before it fills the 38 GB disk mid-week.

A stale citation ('Art 4.2 conflict gate') in the dead Charter E pre-reg propagated by copy into two live drafts, establishing that dead/quarantined documents are citation-quarantined and must be re-grepped before inheritance.
learnings.evidence: 2026-08-03 Event-market-tape review closed; registry ghost-citation lesson

learnings.claim: The §1.5 premise check found 11 liquid OUTCOME series intersecting 8-K companies but 0 of them resolve within 90 days (all settle 2027-2028 as annual KPIs), so event flow (~1-2/quarter) falls far below the 8/quarter bar.
The event-market tape's sole remaining consumer (the W3 duel) gates nothing while E² is not live, so a duel-only tape loses to the §B odd-lot premise check on expected value.
